fields.note: No tourist visa for Canadians for stays of up to 30 days. From 1 January 2026 nationals of 91 listed countries must hold a visa before arrival — Canada is NOT on that list, and Canadian residence permits are separately named as exempting their holders. But PRE-REGISTRATION ON THE EASE PLATFORM IS COMPULSORY for every foreign traveller, ideally at least 5 days before travel, and the airport security tax is paid through it. Canada's travel advice calls this pre-registration an ETA: complete the online form and pay the airport security fee at least 5 days before you arrive. Yellow fever proof only if arriving from a risk country.

fields.stay: Up to 90 days in any year

fields.cost: Free for a 30-day visit (Commonwealth fee waiver); otherwise USD 50 single entry, USD 70 multiple entry. East Africa Tourist Visa USD 100
fields.note: Rwanda grants a visa on arrival to citizens of EVERY country with no prior application, and has since 1 January 2018. Canadians get the V1 visitor visa. You can also get it in advance online through Irembo, at an immigration office or at a Rwandan mission. As a Commonwealth country, Canadians get the visa on arrival free for a 30-day visit. The East Africa Tourist Visa (class V11, USD 100) covers Kenya, Uganda and Rwanda and cannot be extended. Yellow fever proof only if arriving from a risk country.

Uganda's '90 days approval validity' is the window in which you must travel, not the stay.

A yellow fever certificate is no longer mandatory for entry (Uganda notice, 2 October 2026).

fields.note: Kazakhstan has run a pilot of its Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA), QazETA, since January 2026 for visa-exempt visitors including Koreans; once the ETA is mandatory, visitors without approval are refused entry. It is not needed if you get a visa from the Kazakh embassy or consulate in Korea. Korean citizens may enter without a visa for up to 30 days after crossing the border, for a total of 60 days in each period of 180 days.

the Embassy of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ottawa
fields.note: This is the DRC (Kinshasa), not Congo-Brazzaville. Canadians must get a visa from the DRC embassy in Ottawa before leaving Canada. You cannot get a visa at a port of entry or at a DRC embassy outside your country of residence. Air passengers leaving the DRC must pay the IDEF airport tax and show proof of payment, called a Go Pass, to board.

fields.note: German citizens need no visa for stays of up to 90 days within 180 days. For longer stays, contact a Solomon Islands mission in advance. The only international airport is in Honiara. Arriving by sea is allowed only at official ports of entry; landing elsewhere brings heavy fines, detention and deportation at your own cost.

German citizens need a visa. Since 1 October 2026 it can be applied for online on the official website and is sent by email as a QR code. Carry a printed copy. Transit visas must still be applied for at a Turkmen embassy or consulate. The visa is not extended. All foreigners must register at the border on arrival and pay a consular fee and a registration fee. Longer stays also need registration with the State Migration Service.

Apply for an e-visa before you leave, on the Indonesian immigration website. It is valid for up to 30 days and can be extended by up to 30 days at Indonesian immigration. Fill in the free All Indonesia Arrival Card online, from 72 hours before arrival. A damaged passport can be refused. On Bali you pay a tourist tax, payable in advance on the LoveBali website.

Since 1 October 2026 tourists need an e-visa. You cannot apply yourself: your tour agency acts as sponsor, and once the visa is approved and paid for through them you receive an e-visa to print or show electronically on arrival. It replaces the old letter of invitation and visa in your passport. Transit visas still need a letter of invitation from the State Migration Service, secured before you travel.

You get a 30-day entry stamp on arrival. Make sure the border officer stamps your passport, and apply at an immigration office if you need to extend. Overstaying can mean a fine before you leave.

Visa-free 90 days. Passport must have 3 blank pages and 6 months validity. ⚠️ Child travel rules — carry the original or a certified copy of the full birth certificate for any child aged 17 or under. If a child travels with only one parent, a guardian or another adult, or alone, carry parental consent or documents showing authority to travel, plus a certified copy of the consenting parent's passport or identity document.

Visa-free, but one thing catches people out: the free Digital Immigration Card is MANDATORY — complete it within the 7 days before departure; it is checked at airline check-in and again on arrival. Canadians can stay 90 days in any 180; to stay longer you must apply to Curaçao's Immigration Service for a short-stay residence permit, not a tourist extension. Proof of funds of about USD 1,000 per week may be requested. Your passport must be valid for the duration of your stay in Curaçao.

fields.apply: Not required · an Electronic Travel Authorization (QazETA) is recommended: apply no later than 72 hours before the planned travel date
fields.note: Canada is named in Kazakhstan's visa-regime table as visa-free up to 30 days for ordinary passports. Watch the cumulative caps — the 30 days is per entry, but total stay must not exceed 90 days in any 180-day period, and not more than 120 days in one calendar year. On registration: an arrival notification is required within 3 working days, but it is the duty of the RECEIVING PARTY — your hotel or host — not you, and Kazakhstan states a foreign citizen does not need to apply to the migration service personally. Kazakhstan is piloting an Electronic Travel Authorization (ETA), QazETA; Canada's advice recommends getting one before you travel. It is currently voluntary and free of charge, but may become mandatory and could carry fees. An ETA does not guarantee entry.

fields.apply: Up to 30 days: no visa needed. Apply for an ETA through the QazETA app before you travel. It is being phased in by border crossing: since 1 November 2026 at Aktau airport and the land crossings Urljutobe, Auhatty, Atameken and Nurly Zhol; from 1 January 2027 at Astana and Almaty airports; from 1 March 2027 at all other crossings; mandatory from 1 July 2027. Longer than 30 days: visa applied for in advance at a Kazakh embassy or consulate
fields.note: No visa is needed for stays up to 30 days. An ETA via the QazETA app is being phased in by border crossing and becomes mandatory on 1 July 2027; until then travellers without one may be told they need it but, according to the Kazakh authorities, are not refused entry. A stay beyond 30 days needs a visa applied for in advance at a Kazakh embassy or consulate.

fields.apply: Up to 30 days: no visa needed, but you may need an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA): see the QazETA website. Longer: visa from the Kazakh Embassy in The Hague
fields.note: No visa is needed for stays up to 30 days on a Dutch passport. You may need an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA); the Dutch advice points to the QazETA website. Longer stays need a visa from the Kazakh Embassy in The Hague. Passport must be valid at least 6 months from departure.

fields.blurb: A new decree, Disposición No. 002-2026, took effect on 16 February 2026 and reshuffled which nationalities need a visa, so treat older answers as unreliable. Nicaragua is also in the CA-4 zone: the 90-day allowance is shared with Guatemala, Honduras and El Salvador and does not reset at those borders.

Passports need three blank pages and six months' validity. Child travel rules are unusually strict: carry the original or a certified copy of the full birth certificate for any child aged 17 or under, plus parental consent or documents showing authority to travel when a child travels with one parent, a guardian, another adult or alone.

A free visitor permit is issued at the border: less than 31 days for most nationalities, three months for New Zealand and Australian citizens, so New Zealand sources do not read across. You need proof of onward travel and sufficient funds, and work or study is not allowed. Extensions are applied for locally and carry a fee.
